title: local ssh-add -L lists keys behind the inherited agent
reason_not_testable: Signing by child processes that use the inherited agent socket leaves no trace in tool output, so no output hook fixture can observe it. The public-key-line pass-through half is covered by FP-0106. Non-hook control: unset SSH_AUTH_SOCK for agent Bash sessions or run the agent under a sandbox that denies the socket (catalog mitigation, UNVERIFIED in this repo).
